integrity: The primary full HTML article was inspected at the DAPW PMF/CDF, mixed upper-lower record construction, lower-record Eq. (14), upper-record Eq. (15), Bayesian mixed-record reuse of that likelihood, simulation discussion, publication date, and primary MSC. Classical and discrete-record sources were checked for the strict-record convention. A standalone checker was replayed from the packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The correction is conditional on an observed strict lower-record sequence and does not analyze termination of discrete lower-record sampling plans.
The article's numerical mixed-record experiments are not reconstructed.
Weak records with ties are a different record process and are outside the claim.
title: The DAPW mixed-record likelihood uses the wrong denominator for discrete lower records
